reference_search.method: Case-insensitive byte search for each complete asset filename ending in .act. The assets own actor INI is excluded from cross-reference findings.
reference_search.result: No references to these thirteen ACT filenames were found in these scopes outside their own actor INIs.
reference_search.limits: This establishes no explicit shipped filename references in the inspected content. It is not a native runtime trace or proof against every dynamically constructed filename. No native enemy AI was established for these variants.

room_policy.gallery_placement: New room placements; not recovered original campaign placements.
room_policy.transform: Use each imported own-INI scale and rotation where present. tstwitch uses importer defaults because no own INI exists.
room_policy.animation: Models without embedded clips remain static; selecting a clip plays its imported original keyframes. Any looping preview or user selection is gallery control, not recovered gameplay.
